name: Shibue Akira
source:
Akira is the protagonist of the game.
He seems to have a thing for his childhood friend [url=https://vndb.org/c45579]Riri[/url] but she is already in a relationship with another common childhood friend of both of them so he tells her nothing about his feeling for her.
He has a huge admiration for his senpai [url=https://vndb.org/c45578]Rui[/url], that he sees as a potential romantic interest even if he thinks she is inaccessible for him because she is too beautiful and nice.
